<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Bolas em Nonágono Rotativo</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #0d1117; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  canvas { background: #131a24; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="720" height="720"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  var W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  var CX = W / 2, CY = H / 2;

  var N = 9;
  var R = 260;
  var PERIOD = 7;
  var OMEGA = 2 * Math.PI / PERIOD;
  var BALL_R = 14;
  var NUM_BALLS = 13;
  var GRAVITY = 900;
  var AIR_DRAG = 0.10;
  var REST = 0.82;
  var FRICTION = 0.12;
  var VELOCITY_STOP = 3;

  var t = 0;
  var balls = [];

  (function initBalls() {
    var ring = 62;
    for (var i = 0; i < NUM_BALLS - 1; i++) {
      var a = (i / (NUM_BALLS - 1)) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
      balls.push({
        id: i,
        x: CX + Math.cos(a) * ring,
        y: CY + Math.sin(a) * ring,
        vx: 0, vy: 0,
        r: BALL_R,
        omega: 0,
        angle: i * 0.7
      });
    }
    balls.push({ id: 12, x: CX, y: CY, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R, omega: 0, angle: 0.35 });
  })();

  function polyVertices(theta) {
    var v = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) {
      var a = theta + (i * 2 * Math.PI) / N;
      v.push({ x: CX + R * Math.cos(a), y: CY + R * Math.sin(a) });
    }
    return v;
  }

  function integrate(dt) {
    var drag = Math.exp(-AIR_DRAG * dt);
    var spinDamp = Math.exp(-0.4 * dt);
    for (var i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
      var b = balls[i];
      b.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
      b.vx *= drag;
      b.vy *= drag;
      b.x += b.vx * dt;
      b.y += b.vy * dt;
      b.omega *= spinDamp;
      b.angle += b.omega * dt;
    }
  }

  function collideBalls() {
    for (var iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
      var any = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < balls.length; i++) {
        for (var j = i + 1; j < balls.length; j++) {
          var a = balls[i], b = balls[j];
          var dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
          var d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          var minD = a.r + b.r;
          if (d2 >= minD * minD) continue;
          var d = Math.sqrt(d2);
          var nx, ny;
          if (d < 1e-9) { nx = 1; ny = 0; d = 1e-9; } else { nx = dx / d; ny = dy / d; }
          var pen = minD - d;
          a.x -= nx * pen / 2; a.y -= ny * pen / 2;
          b.x += nx * pen / 2; b.y += ny * pen / 2;
          var rvx = b.vx - a.vx, rvy = b.vy - a.vy;
          var vn = rvx * nx + rvy * ny;
          if (vn < 0) {
            var e = -vn > VELOCITY_STOP ? REST : 0;
            var jimp = -(1 + e) * vn / 2;
            a.vx -= jimp * nx; a.vy -= jimp * ny;
            b.vx += jimp * nx; b.vy += jimp * ny;
            var tx = -ny, ty = nx;
            var vt = (b.vx - a.vx) * tx + (b.vy - a.vy) * ty;
            var fimp = vt * FRICTION / 2;
            a.vx += fimp * tx; a.vy += fimp * ty;
            b.vx -= fimp * tx; b.vy -= fimp * ty;
            var slip = vt / a.r;
            a.omega += (slip - a.omega) * 0.15;
            b.omega += (-slip - b.omega) * 0.15;
            any = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (!any) break;
    }
  }

  function collideWalls(theta) {
    var verts = polyVertices(theta);
    var edges = [];
    for (var e = 0; e < N; e++) {
      var A = verts[e], B = verts[(e + 1) % N];
      var abx = B.x - A.x, aby = B.y - A.y;
      var len = Math.sqrt(abx * abx + aby * aby);
      var nx = -aby / len, ny = abx / len;
      var mx = (A.x + B.x) / 2, my = (A.y + B.y) / 2;
      if ((CX - mx) * nx + (CY - my) * ny < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      edges.push({ ax: A.x, ay: A.y, nx: nx, ny: ny });
    }
    for (var iter = 0; iter < 8; iter++) {
      var any = false;
      for (var bi = 0; bi < balls.length; bi++) {
        var b = balls[bi];
        for (var ei = 0; ei < edges.length; ei++) {
          var ed = edges[ei];
          var d = (b.x - ed.ax) * ed.nx + (b.y - ed.ay) * ed.ny;
          if (d >= b.r) continue;
          var pen = b.r - d;
          b.x += ed.nx * pen;
          b.y += ed.ny * pen;
          var px = b.x - ed.nx * b.r;
          var py = b.y - ed.ny * b.r;
          var wvx = -OMEGA * (py - CY);
          var wvy = OMEGA * (px - CX);
          var rvx = b.vx - wvx, rvy = b.vy - wvy;
          var vn = rvx * ed.nx + rvy * ed.ny;
          if (vn < 0) {
            var e = -vn > VELOCITY_STOP ? REST : 0;
            var jn = -(1 + e) * vn;
            rvx += jn * ed.nx;
            rvy += jn * ed.ny;
            var tx = -ed.ny, ty = ed.nx;
            var vt = rvx * tx + rvy * ty;
            rvx -= FRICTION * vt * tx;
            rvy -= FRICTION * vt * ty;
            var slip = (rvx * tx + rvy * ty) / b.r;
            b.omega += (slip - b.omega) * 0.4;
            b.vx = rvx + wvx;
            b.vy = rvy + wvy;
          }
          any = true;
        }
      }
      if (!any) break;
    }
  }

  function substep(dt) {
    integrate(dt);
    collideBalls();
    collideWalls(OMEGA * t);
  }

  function step(dt) {
    if (!(dt > 0)) return;
    var SUB = 240;
    var n = Math.max(1, Math.min(1000, Math.round(dt * SUB)));
    var h = dt / n;
    for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      t += h;
      substep(h);
    }
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#131a24';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    var theta = OMEGA * t;
    var verts = polyVertices(theta);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(verts[0].x, verts[0].y);
    for (var i = 1; i < N; i++) ctx.lineTo(verts[i].x, verts[i].y);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(80,120,200,0.08)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5eead4';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
    for (var v = 0; v < N; v++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(verts[v].x, verts[v].y, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.fill();
    }

    for (var bi = 0; bi < balls.length; bi++) {
      var b = balls[bi];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.rotate(b.angle);
      var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-4, -5, 2, 0, 0, b.r);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#fda4af');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#e11d48');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, b.r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(b.r * 0.55, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(b.r * 0.95, 0);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = 'bold 13px system-ui, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillText(String(b.id), 0, 0.5);
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  var last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    var dt = (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    if (dt > 0) step(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);

  window.__bench = {
    getState: function () {
      return {
        t: t,
        poly: {
          n: 9,
          radius: 260,
          cx: CX,
          cy: CY,
          angle: OMEGA * t,
          periodSec: 7
        },
        balls: balls.map(function (b) {
          return { id: b.id, x: b.x, y: b.y, r: b.r, vx: b.vx, vy: b.vy };
        })
      };
    },
    step: function (dtSeconds) {
      step(dtSeconds);
    }
  };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
